acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Doppelgangers family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Facewearer, T4, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Three-Face Champion (Champion) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Flawless copy wearing three layered faces like masks, each shifting to the front in turn.
Signature mechanic: Front in Turn: three layered faces rotate through the front position, each calling a learned reach, cut, or mirrored response while the vacated edge stays open.
battlefieldDuty: Control three alternating attack rules by rotating layered faces to the front of an otherwise flawless copy.
constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 blank smooth flesh and one featureless limb gain an external pressure loop without marking the body; T2 the partial copy and unfinished arm gain a reflective copied-surface fill; T3 the jaw seam and wrong hand gain coherent conduits; T4 layered faces and mask edges gain mist valves; T5 body-wide faces and mask crown gain bounded cistern latches.

Motion/process branches: T1 the blank featureless limb fills and drains one external silhouette loop; T2 the partial copy drains color toward the unfinished arm; T3 the wrong hand reverses jaw-seam conduit flow; T4 layered faces rotate fluid through one mask valve; T5 body-wide faces pressurize and empty one mask-crown latch.
counterplay: Read the incoming profile, answer its familiar rule, and strike the trailing mask edge after it rotates away. Affinity signal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 pressure loss opens the blank smooth-flesh featureless-limb loop; T2 the partial copy exposes a drained fill at the unfinished arm; T3 the jaw seam and wrong hand expose the empty conduit after reversal; T4 layered faces expose the mask valve after drainage; T5 body-wide faces expose the mask-crown cistern latch after pressure loss, preserving copy readability.
forbiddenTreatments: Reflection or mist that hides copied-versus-native anatomy
identityInvariants: A generic humanoid copy silhouette retains one deliberate flaw until layered face and mask motifs appear at explicit upper tiers.
Clay-grey skin, putty, borrowed colors, porcelain, copied cloth, and smooth flesh remain discrete source materials rather than Earth affinity.
Seams, wrong joints, ill-fitting clothes, and layered masks reveal copy quality while preserving the readable original-copy relationship.
Disguise fidelity escalates from an entirely blank true form to a sovereign carrying many stolen-looking faces at once.
telegraph: Two mask profiles slide backward and the third face becomes unnaturally still before its rule begins.
